name: hermes-tweet
description: Native Hermes Agent X/Twitter plugin for Xquik automation with read-first workflows and approval-gated actions. Not affiliated with X Corp.

interface.shortDescription: Read-first X research and gated actions through Hermes Agent
interface.longDescription: Route public X/Twitter research, support triage, monitoring plans, private reads, persistent resources, media operations, and account actions through the native Hermes Tweet plugin. Public reads stay read-only; every private, persistent, metered, media, or account action requires an explicit approval gate.
defaultPrompt: Research these public X posts through Hermes Tweet.
Prepare a read-only social-signal brief with source links.
Plan this X account action and stop before the approval gate.
